name: Oharion
storyline:
Explore a vast open world filled with cities, dungeons, castles, ancient forests, dangerous deserts, and regions controlled by elemental creatures. Develop your character through equipment, skills, attributes, professions, and long-term progression systems.

Become a powerful warrior, elemental mage, archer, druid, or other available classes in the world of Oharion. Customize your build through skills, equipment, and attributes to create your own combat style.

Elemental dragons directly influence the balance of the world. As ancient forces awaken once again, players must face legendary creatures, explore forgotten regions, and take part in the conflict between kingdoms, guilds, and factions.

Defeat monsters, obtain rare equipment, unlock new powers, and participate in competitive events in an MMORPG focused on constant progression and long-term challenges.
summary:
Oharion is an online MMORPG focused on progression, exploration, competitive PvP, and cooperative battles in a fantasy world shaped by elemental forces and ancient dragons.

Explore a vast open world filled with cities, dungeons, castles, ancient forests, dangerous deserts, and regions controlled by elemental creatures. Develop your character through equipment, skills, attributes, professions, and long-term progression systems.
